title: Interpretable and Fair Generalized Additive Neural Networks via Multi-objective Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.05946v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Interpretability and fairness are two of the most emphasized dimensions in trustworthy artificial intelligence (AI). Various explainable AI methods have been introduced to improve interpretability. This paper focuses on neural network (NN)-based generalized additive models (GAMs), a class of self-interpretable models. While most existing research has prioritized improving the accuracy of NN-based GAMs, their interpretability remains largely underexplored. To address this gap, this paper introduces explicit quantitative metrics for evaluating the interpretability of NN-based GAMs, empirically examines their effectiveness, and explores strategies for improving interpretability within these models. In addition, the simultaneous and explicit optimization of both interpretability and fairness, along with their trade-offs and the underlying reasons, remains underexplored. To address this, we propose a multi-objective neural basis model (MONBM)

translated_title: 通过多目标学习实现可解释且公平的广义可加神经网络
translated_abstract: 可解释性和公平性是可信人工智能（AI）中最受重视的两个维度。为了提高可解释性，已有多种可解释AI方法被提出。本文聚焦于基于神经网络（NN）的广义可加模型（GAM），这是一类自解释模型。虽然现有研究大多优先考虑提高基于神经网络的广义可加模型的准确性，但其可解释性在很大程度上仍未得到充分探索。为填补这一空白，本文引入了用于评估基于神经网络的广义可加模型可解释性的显式定量指标，通过实验验证了这些指标的有效性，并探索了提升这些模型可解释性的策略。此外，可解释性与公平性的同时显式优化，以及两者之间的权衡及其深层原因，也仍然缺乏充分研究。为此，我们提出了一种多目标神经基模型（MONBM）。
tldr: 本文提出多目标神经基模型（MONBM），通过引入可解释性的显式定量指标，首次实现了基于神经网络的广义可加模型中可解释性与公平性的同时优化，并深入分析了两者的权衡关系。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a multi-objective neural basis model (MONBM) that introduces explicit quantitative interpretability metrics, enabling simultaneous optimization of interpretability and fairness in neural network-based generalized additive models with analysis of their trade-offs.
